primary_object_card.object_statement: A finite source-relative manifold candidate is the complete tuple of base, nesting, geometry, connection, and ordered history, settled under explicit restrictions and concrete witnesses into a plural frontier with re-offerable Purgatory.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The object is the full finite candidate tuple, not any one layer or score. Each base, nesting, geometry, connection, and ordered-history choice is evaluated under the same source-relative restrictions. Comparisons retain concrete distinguishing witnesses, preserve every unbeaten candidate in a plural frontier, and place beaten candidates in Purgatory with an explicit rule that re-offers them whenever a later layer or revised requirement changes the comparison.
primary_object_card.domain: the nine vendored source packets, vendored finite algebra and QCA modules, and existing system_v8 manifold result receipts
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: deterministic layer receipts, a complete deep candidate census, a plural frontier, and witness-bound Purgatory records

native_terms.settle: Evaluate a proposed finite candidate under the active Z restrictions plus its declared delta without treating survival as finality.
native_terms.witness comparison: Compare two complete candidate tuples using a concrete state or restriction result that distinguishes their admissibility records.
native_terms.Purgatory re-offer: Retain an excluded candidate together with its defeating witness and reconsider it after every later layer or requirement revision.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Run the whole manifold as one settled object through connection, history, persistence, and chirality while retaining a plural frontier and re-offering Purgatory.
The manifold is an admissible ratchet surface; transport, history, chirality, and entropy readouts must remain typed and claim-bounded.

weirdness_signature: the candidate is the entire cross-layer tuple rather than a winning individual layer
beaten candidates remain re-offerable when a later layer changes the active restrictions
noncommutation is earned only by a concrete state-pair order witness
chirality may be expressible and installable while remaining unforced
allowed_operations: propose a finite candidate from the declared grammar
settle the candidate under Z plus its declared delta
compare complete candidates by concrete witness
re-offer every Purgatory candidate after a layer or requirement change
required_invariants: all nine source packets remain represented
entropy and geometry remain late readouts rather than base probability primitives
ordered histories retain order-sensitive witnesses or an explicit negative result
chirality remains unforced unless the finite comparison forces it
no survivor is called final and every exclusion retains a re-offer rule
forbidden_substitutions: replace the complete tuple with a scalar score proxy
replace an order witness with a noncommutation label
replace installed chirality with a forced-chirality claim
replace source-relative survival with a final manifold analogy
negative_controls: transport a state outside the outer admissible set
swap restriction order and require a concrete distinguishing state pair
erase a surviving distinction from persistence inventory
collapse the frontier or remove a Purgatory re-offer rule
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Vendored algebra and QCA reports are probes or adapters only; each must name preserved fields, losses, preconditions, and a kill control before affecting comparison.
promotion_locks: the proposal grammar cannot be called exhaustive
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: new deterministic JSON receipts under system_v8/manifold/results/deep plus additive engine and runner files

lateral_mappings.label: spinor density-sign report
loses: the full manifold tuple and outer admissibility relation
preconditions: source report passes and transported states are checked against outer admissibility
lateral_mappings.kill_control: a transported state outside the outer admissible set rejects the transport candidate

lateral_mappings.label: QCA transition permutation
preserves: finite transition-table state identity and packet lineage
loses: geometry and chirality unless separately attached
preconditions: the transition table is bijective on the tested finite state set
lateral_mappings.kill_control: a collision, missing image, or inadmissible outer image rejects the adapter

lateral_mappings.label: octonion bracketing orientation readout
loses: any claim that orientation is forced across all candidate manifolds
preconditions: the vendored octonion report passes its exact witness checks
lateral_mappings.kill_control: if a nonchiral candidate remains admissible, chirality must stay merely installable

root_constraints: finite carrier and finite proposal grammar
noncommuting or order-sensitive operation with an explicit control

fixation_breakers: re-offer every base, nesting, geometry, connection, and history candidate after a new layer arrives
demote any scalar or single-layer winner that drops complete-tuple fields

loop_contract.stop_condition: the additive deep pipeline passes fresh semantic verification and deterministic replay, or a named source invariant cannot be preserved
loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first failing object-preservation or receipt-semantic check before widening the proposal grammar

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question is not authorization to implement; this explicit build request supplies the implementation authority.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Check order separately from content correctness and record the concrete state-pair order witness or explicit negative.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: Preserve the existing visible and result baseline while debugging the new additive runtime path underneath it.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: For each target claim name the strongest falsifier, run the decisive check, and classify it as killed, open, or survived.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: Name the operation, observable, and pass/fail condition for every connection, history, persistence, and chirality check.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must refuse to merge expressible or installable chirality with forced chirality, or runtime survival with formal admission.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve tool-recoverable work before asking the human; ask only when required private or unrecoverable information remains.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 current object-preservation guard; v4.2 is legacy/provenance and is not the current run target.

source_math_locks.preserves: exact build order, additive-only scope, receipt fields, and fresh-run acceptance conditions
finite manifold, transport, history, chirality, and late-readout claim boundaries

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: object-preservation preflight for a packet-relative deterministic diagnostic; no promotion, formal admission, physics, finality, or exhaustive-grammar claim
